overview_description.description: Soon is a fully automated cryptocurrency investing platform to help users build wealth without the stress of speculating. It puts their hard-earned money to work. Soon achieves this by investing a portion of each deposit and then spending the investment gains when they spend with Soon. Consumers receive an automated wealth engine that eliminates the need to time the market and requires no prior investing experience. The platform increases probability by investing in and tracking hundreds of cryptocurrency positions each month, which are taken daily, at different prices, and across various assets.
